                                                           NOTICE
                          Submission of Application Forms under MMNMA and MMNBA, 2026-27
             Alleligible UG and PG students are informed that application-form distribution under the Mukhya
            Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni(MMNMA) and the Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Babu Aasoni (MMNBA) has
            commenced for 2026-27. MMNMA is for eligible female students, and MMNBA is for eligible male
            students.
            Important Dates
                    Distribution of application forms: From 6 August 2026 to 11 August 2026
                    Submission of the completed application form and documents to the College: 12 August 2026
            to 14 August 2026
             UGand PG students must submit the hard copyof the duly filled and signed application form with the
            required documents.
            Mandatory Requirements
                      The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam and possess avalid Aadhaar number.
                      An Aadhaar-seeded bank account enabled for the Aadhaar-Based Payment System (ABPS).
                    Matching name and particulars in the Aadhaar card, bank account, application form and
            College records.
            Documents to be Submitted
                    Duly filled and signed hard copy of the application form.
                    Photocopyof the Aadhaar card.
                      Photocopy of the Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook.
                    Admission receipt or proof of current admission.
                    Prescribed Student Undertaking/Declaration and Aadhaar consent, signed as required by the
            student and parent/guardian.
                    Other documents applicable under the respective scheme.
            Additional eligibility: MMNBA is limited to regular male students of UG 1st/2nd Year and PG 1st/2nd Year
            admitted under the Fee Waiver Scheme, with family income below Rs. 4.00 lakh. UG applicants under either
            scheme must be unmarried and must not opt for the Dr. Banikanta Kakati Merit Award/Scooter Scheme: these
            restrictions do not apply to PG. PG students receiving the Chief Minister's Jibon Prerana Scheme benefit are
            ineligible. Students not enrolled for the previous final examination are ineligible; continuing beneficiaries require
            at least 70% attendance. MMNBA applicants must submit Fee Waiver proof and a valid income certificate or
            parent's ration card.
            Important: Studernts must verify their Aadhaar number, bank account number and IFSCcode before
            submission. Incomplete applications or applications containing incorrect information may be rejected.
